hypotheses.A1_scalar256_is_sufficient: At least half of active addresses reach held-out derivative R-squared 0.90 at rank 256 after one train-fitted scalar gain.
hypotheses.A2_coordinate256_is_sufficient: At least half of active addresses reach held-out derivative R-squared 0.90 at rank 256 after a train-fitted 4x4 address-coordinate map.
hypotheses.A3_scalar_calibration_transfers: Train-fitted scalar calibration improves held-out rank-256 R-squared by at least 0.10 for every active address.
hypotheses.A4_coordinate_map_adds_value: The 4x4 coordinate map improves median held-out rank-256 R-squared by at least 0.02 beyond scalar calibration.
hypotheses.A5_rank256_direction_is_high_fidelity: Every active address has rank-256 held-out squared cosine at least 0.90.
hypotheses.A6_calibrated_description_is_compact: The median smallest rank reaching held-out R-squared 0.90 with either frozen calibration is at most 256.
